base.description: ref to read .ai-sdlc.yaml from (advisory — falls back to default engine)

engine_name.description: resolved engine adapter id — recorded on the ledger entry

escalation_label.description: resolved escalation label applied when the fix produces no push

findings_json.description: bounded findings JSON from the verdict record

fix_attempt.description: fix attempt number (from the review stage fix_attempt output)

head_ref.description: PR head branch to push to

head_sha.description: PR head SHA the blocking verdict consumed

provider_base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible inference base URL; empty → vars.AI_SDLC_PROVIDER_URL → GitHub Models default

runtime_ref.description: ref of os-santiago/ai-sdlc to fetch runtime scripts/actions from

AI_SDLC_APP_ID.description: ai-sdlc GitHub App id (fail-closed when unset; issue #26)

AI_SDLC_LEDGER_KEY.description: run-ledger signing key (PEM); absent = unsigned seal

MODEL_API_KEY.description: optional direct provider key; absent → GitHub Models via GITHUB_TOKEN
